run_mfg_dqn_fp: run deep fictitious play with DQN agents on an MFG game using configurable hyperparameters
create_mfg_game: create an MFG game environment with factory.create_game_with_setting and configure player distributions
train_dqn_agents: train DQN agents with configurable replay buffer, learning rate, and exploration parameters
compute_nash_conv: compute Nash convexity metrics for evaluating fictitious play policy convergence
log_training_metrics: log training metrics including agent loss, policy values, and Nash convexity to a writer
